exposure: small for gestational age (SGA) infants (birth weight <10th percentile)
cohort: Singleton deliveries >24 weeks with macrosomia (birth weight ≥4000 g) or SGA (birth weight <10th percentile)
finding: A sonoEFW prior to delivery is independently associated with cesarean delivery in women with macrosomic infants, but not those with SGA infants.
mod_finding: A sonographic estimated fetal weight prior to delivery is independently associated with cesarean delivery in women with macrosomic infants.
birth_weight: Macrosomic infants (birth weight ≥4000 g) or SGA (birth weight <10th percentile)
